skills: A 4-hit combo. The heavy hit uses up to 3 Gash stacks, setting off one Maim per stack. Hits 3–4 have higher Anti-Interrupt and 40% less DMG taken; hit 4 is invulnerable.
Eldreda's 4-hit combo, with the same Gash and Maim finisher and hit 3–4 bonuses.
Hold Basic Attack with enough Kinetic Energy (costs 120 Willpower): switches to Eldreda for an invulnerable Genesis Flare attack.
Lindverne's and Eldreda's invulnerable dodges. Basic Attack during the dodge gives a dash attack (Void Slash Rush / Reality Reversal).
Hold Dodge with a direction to enter Nightglide; Basic Attack then triggers Shadow Realm Raid, a Tail Swipe.
Smoldering Fire Reignition / Cold Flame Returning Edge
Lindverne's and Eldreda's Dodge Counters after a Perfect Dodge. Invulnerable.
Dauntless Aid / Path of the Gleaming Edge
Brings in Lindverne or Eldreda for an invulnerable attack.
Dracaene parries the attack for heavy Daze. Invulnerable.
Dracaene grapples certain Control Skills, cancelling them and dealing Genesis Flare DMG.
Follow-ups by Dracaene (applies 1 Gash on the heavy hit), Lindverne and Eldreda.
Switches to Lindverne or Eldreda for Genesis Flare DMG.
Lindverne and Eldreda attack together, finishing with Gash and Maim. Dawnborn can follow certain skills and uses every Gash on the target (up to 3) for one AoE Maim each. Invulnerable.
Eldreda's linked attack with the Gash and Maim finisher; a Revised version follows certain skills.
End of the Long Dark / Torch of Eternal Day
Needs Chain Teeth (Lindverne) or a held Flag Order (Eldreda): massive Genesis Flare DMG.
Building Dreams for All / In the Name of Sunbringer
Joint attacks of Lindverne and Eldreda, finishing with Gash and Maim. Invulnerable.
At max Decibels: all three sisters attack together. A held Flag Order becomes a Wish Core. Invulnerable.
Needs a Wish Core: an airborne attack that removes all Ember Scar and deals the same amount as direct HP loss. Invulnerable.

core.name: Sharp Edge, Midnight Sun and Ember Scar
core.text:
Her skills deal Sharp DMG, which scales with DEF, and can stack up to 3 Gash. Sharp CRITs use a Laceration DMG Bonus instead of CRIT DMG; each 1% initial CRIT DMG adds 0.35% initial CRIT Rate, and CRIT Rate above 100% gives an extra Laceration check.
Entering the field restores 60 Sharpness. Entering combat gives Midnight Sun for 15s: +40% CRIT Rate and 20% enemy DEF ignored; EX Special Attacks and Converging Edge refresh it.
Each Gash removed by a squad member's Maim gives 40 Willpower (max 160).
Converging Edge, some EX Special Attacks and her Ultimates store 75% of their DMG as Ember Scar, which her second Ultimate turns into direct HP loss.

ability.name: Laceration Enhance
ability.text: Eldreda's Roaming Attack dash or certain EX Special Attack switch-ins give all Armorer Agents +25% Laceration DMG for 45s.
